svg.data-weight: 14.8 kg (32.6 lbs) for the 7280CR3A-24D12, 7280CR3AM-24D12 and 7280CR3AK-24D12 (guide Table 1); 32.6 lbs (14.79 kg) in the data sheet
svg.data-size-over-ears: 48.3 x 4.4 x 59.2 cm (19 x 1.75 x 23.3 in) with the mounting ears (guide Table 1)
svg.data-power-draw-note: Data sheet: "346 W / 845 W", typical measured at 25 C ambient with 50 percent load on all ports, excluding transceivers. Guide Table 4 reads TBD.
svg.data-storage-temp-datasheet: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F), per the data sheet
svg.data-software: EOS; minimum release 4.31.1 per the data sheet
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: each of the 24 QSFP cages runs 100G, or 40G (QSFP+), 50G and 25/10G modes by breakout (data sheet)
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: each of the 12 QSFP-DD cages runs 400G, or 100G, 50G, 40G and 25/10G modes by breakout (data sheet)
svg.data-precision-timing: PTP and SyncE with OCXO and PPS/10M/ToD inputs
svg.data-encryption: none on the 7280CR3A-24D12; all ports (MACsec, IPsec and VXLANsec) on the 7280CR3AM-24D12 and 7280CR3AK-24D12
svg.data-console: RJ-45 serial (RS-232), 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, no flow control
svg.data-emissions: FCC Class A, ICES-003 Issue 7, EN 55032:2015, VCCI-CISPR 32:2016, AS/NZS CISPR 32:2015
